title.narrative: Pride Receptions to mark Pride Month

description.narrative:
This project aims to advance the rights and visibility of the LGBTIQ+ community in Vietnam by hosting two high-profile Pride events at the British Embassy in Hanoi and the British Consulate General in Ho Chi Minh City. By leveraging the UK’s strong reputation as an advocate for LGBTIQ+ rights, the events will raise awareness of LGBTIQ+ issues, foster allyship, and reinforce the importance of protecting civic space.
Activities such as film screening and panel/group conversations with community activists will highlight the lived realities of LGBTIQ+ people in Vietnam, creating a platform for shared experiences and collective reflection on the country’s evolving social landscape, including public discussion around the draft same-sex marriage law. The evening receptions will further these outputs by celebrating diversity through cultural performances, mobilising allies, and strengthening collaboration with Hanoi Pride, VietPride, and partner organisations.
These outputs serve the project’s broader purpose: to sustain and empower networks of activists, organisations, and allies in a challenging environment. By keeping civic space open, nurturing dialogue, and connecting communities with supportive partners, the project helps maintain momentum for future progress and positions activists to engage more effectively when conditions allow.
